metadata.name: Done @ Greentic
metadata.summary: Ask a person to do something and react when they answer
metadata.description: Flow steps Create request and Read request, the Done event trigger, and the done_api tool for agentic workers, all backed by a Done Core deployed from Greentic. A request is created with a caller-generated UUID v7 over HTTPS; the outcome arrives later as a signed event, so a flow reacts in a second flow and never parks while a person decides.

tools.name: done_api
tools.description: Ask a person to do something through Done and track the answer. create_request returns the request id immediately; the real outcome arrives later, read it with read_request. The credential is injected by the host and never returned.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","required":["action"],"properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["create_request","read_request"],"description":"create_request asks a person to do something; read_request returns the state of an existing request."},"to":{"type":"string","description":"create_request: who is asked (an email address or a Done person id)."},"request":{"type":"string","description":"create_request: what is being asked, in plain words."},"due":{"type":"string","description":"create_request: optional due date, YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339."},"process_id":{"type":"string","description":"create_request: optional Done process this request belongs to."},"callback_trigger":{"type":"string","description":"create_request: optional trigger id to notify when the request changes."},"context":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":true,"description":"create_request: small JSON echoed back in events (4 KiB max). Never put credentials in it."},"id":{"type":"string","description":"read_request: the request id returned by create_request. create_request: optional, supply the same id on a retry so the request is created once."}}}

secret_requirements.description: Bearer key for the Done Core API. Resolved by the host from secret://done/api_key and never returned to the model.
HTTPS origin of the Done Core deployment, for example https://core.example.com. Resolved by the host from secret://done/base_url.
Shared secret that signs Done events (HMAC-SHA256, header X-Done-Signature). Needed only by flows that use the Done event trigger.
